papers.title: E2F4 gene therapy reverses established synaptic and cognitive deficits and remodels learning-associated signaling in Alzheimer's disease mice
papers.translated_title: E2F4基因治疗逆转阿尔茨海默病小鼠已形成的突触和认知缺陷并重塑学习相关信号
papers.author: Sanchez-Puelles, C.
papers.summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) causes progressive synaptic dysfunction, neurodegeneration, and cognitive decline, yet strategies capable of reversing established deficits remain limited. Here, we show that neuronal expression of a p38MAPK phosphorylation-resistant human E2F4 variant (hE2F4DN), delivered by adeno-associated virus, restores hippocampal long-term potentiation and memory in homozygous 5xFAD mice after functional impairment is established. Treatment also reduces amyloid-{beta} and phospho-tau pathology and prevents hippocampal neuronal loss. Integrated proteomic and phosphoproteomic analyses reveal remodeling of metabolic, redox, neuroimmune, synaptic-vesicle, and GSK3{beta}-associated signaling pathways. Following contextual fear conditioning, hE2F4DN-treated mice exhibit broader learning-associated synaptic proteomic signatures and distinct phosphoregulatory responses involving synaptic machinery. These findings demonstrate that E2F4 gene therapy can reverse established synaptic and cognitive deficits while preserving neuronal integrity and reshaping molecular responses to learning, identifying E2F4 phosphorylation as a potential therapeutic target for advanced AD states.
papers.translated_summary: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）导致进行性突触功能障碍、神经退行性变和认知衰退，然而能够逆转已确立缺陷的策略仍然有限。在此，我们表明，通过腺相关病毒递送的p38MAPK磷酸化抗性人E2F4变体（hE2F4DN）在神经元中的表达，可在功能性损伤确立后恢复纯合5xFAD小鼠的海马长时程增强和记忆。该治疗还减少淀粉样蛋白-β和磷酸化tau病理，并防止海马神经元丢失。整合蛋白质组学和磷酸化蛋白质组学分析揭示了代谢、氧化还原、神经免疫、突触囊泡和GSK3β相关信号通路的重塑。在情境恐惧条件化后，hE2F4DN治疗小鼠表现出更广泛的学习相关突触蛋白质组学特征以及涉及突触机器的独特磷酸化调控反应。这些发现表明，E2F4基因治疗能够逆转已确立的突触和认知缺陷，同时保持神经元完整性并重塑对学习的分子反应，将E2F4磷酸化确定为晚期AD状态的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Magnetic nanoparticle enrichment reveals conserved nitric oxide burst responses in Arabidopsis and wheat
papers.translated_title: 磁性纳米颗粒富集揭示了拟南芥和小麦中保守的一氧化氮爆发响应
papers.author: Ji, R.
papers.summary: Rapid nitric oxide bursts are a conserved response to environmental stimuli, but their effects on cellular S-nitrosylation remain poorly understood. We developed a fluorinated magnetic nanoparticle method for rapid, efficient profiling of S-nitrosylation. Using Arabidopsis and wheat, we treated plant tissues with S-nitrosoglutathione (GSNO) to simulate a rapid nitric oxide surge. The method was then employed to capture S-nitrosylation dynamics within 24 h after treatment. Our analysis revealed sequence-dependent preferences for cysteines near basic or hydrophobic residues. Proteins showing rapid S-nitrosylation increases were predominantly associated with oxidative stress responses and energy metabolism, consistent with our metabolomic data. Functional studies using wheat TaGR1 mutants identified glutathione reductase 1 as a key regulated target. Modification at a conserved cysteine site rapidly modulated cellular glutathione levels in both species. Here, we provide an analytical tool and a multi-omics resource for investigating S-nitrosylation dynamics.
papers.translated_summary: 快速一氧化氮爆发是对环境刺激的一种保守响应，但其对细胞S-亚硝基化修饰的影响仍知之甚少。我们开发了一种氟化磁性纳米颗粒方法，用于快速、高效地分析S-亚硝基化修饰。利用拟南芥和小麦，我们用S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽（GSNO）处理植物组织以模拟一氧化氮的快速升高。随后采用该方法捕获处理后24小时内S-亚硝基化修饰的动态变化。我们的分析揭示了半胱氨酸邻近碱性或疏水性残基的序列依赖性偏好。表现出S-亚硝基化修饰快速增加的蛋白质主要与氧化应激响应和能量代谢相关，这与我们的代谢组学数据一致。利用小麦TaGR1突变体进行的功能研究鉴定出谷胱甘肽还原酶1作为一个关键调控靶标。在一个保守半胱氨酸位点上的修饰可快速调节两种物种中的细胞谷胱甘肽水平。在此，我们提供了一种分析工具和一个多组学资源，用于研究S-亚硝基化修饰的动态变化。

papers.title: N-Hydroxypipecolic Acid Triggers Systemic Acquired Resistance Against Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina) in Wheat
papers.translated_title: N-羟基哌啶酸诱导小麦对叶锈病（Puccinia triticina）的系统获得抗性
papers.author: Sun, S.
papers.summary: Systemic acquired resistance (SAR) represents a conserved immune strategy enabling plants to mount long-lasting, whole-plant protection following localized pathogen challenge. In Arabidopsis thaliana, SAR is orchestrated by the mobile immune regulator N-hydroxypipecolic acid (NHP); however, the extent to which NHP defines systemic immune states in polyploid crops remains unclear. Here, we establish NHP as an inducer of systemic immunity in hexaploid wheat (Triticum aestivum) during infection by the obligate biotrophic fungus Puccinia triticina. Local NHP application conferred robust disease suppression in distal leaves and elicited a temporally structured oxidative response characterized by a distal, biphasic reactive oxygen species (ROS) wave linking local and systemic tissues. RNA-sequencing analysis revealed that NHP induces coordinated transcriptional reprogramming, characterized by systemic activation of pattern-triggered and effector-triggered immunity pathways, WRKY-centered transcriptional networks, NPR1-associated signaling, and broad-spectrum resistance loci including Lr34. Concomitantly, targeted metabolomic profiling revealed a unique systemic accumulation of salicylic acid, salicylic acid glucoside, pipecolic acid, and NHP, without the conventional jasmonate signaling antagonism observed in eudicots. Despite this conserved immune architecture, functional analyses indicated divergence within the NHP biosynthetic pathway; while a single wheat FMO from sub-clade A2 was systemically up-regulated by NHP, the highly conserved TaSARD4 homeologs were constitutively expressed and functionally dispensable for rust resistance in planta. Notably, heterologous expression of TaSARD4-B successfully restored NHP-glucoside accumulation in an Arabidopsis sard4 mutant, confirming biochemical competence and suggesting alternative metabolic redundancies in wheat. These findings define a systems-level NHP-driven immune state in wheat and provide a conceptual framework for dissecting systemic immunity in cereals, extending SAR paradigms beyond model plant systems.
papers.translated_summary: 系统获得性抗性（SAR）是一种保守的免疫策略，使植物在局部病原体侵染后能够建立持久、全株的保护。在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中，SAR由移动性免疫调节因子N-羟基哌啶酸（NHP）协调；然而，NHP在多大程度上定义多倍体作物的系统免疫状态仍不清楚。在此，我们确立NHP为六倍体小麦（Triticum aestivum）在专性活体营养真菌小麦叶锈菌（Puccinia triticina）感染期间系统免疫的诱导因子。局部施用NHP在远端叶片中赋予稳健的病害抑制，并引发一种时间结构化的氧化响应，其特征为连接局部与系统组织的远端双相活性氧（ROS）波。RNA测序分析揭示，NHP诱导协调的转录重编程，其特征为模式触发免疫和效应子触发免疫通路的系统性激活、以WRKY为中心的转录网络、NPR1相关信号传导以及包括Lr34在内的广谱抗性位点。同时，靶向代谢组学分析揭示水杨酸、水杨酸葡萄糖苷、哌啶酸和NHP的独特系统性积累，而未见真双子叶植物中观察到的常规茉莉酸信号拮抗。尽管存在这一保守的免疫架构，功能分析表明NHP生物合成通路内部存在分化；虽然来自亚支A2的单个小麦FMO被NHP系统性上调，但高度保守的TaSARD4同源基因呈组成型表达且在植物体内对锈病抗性功能上非必需。值得注意的是，TaSARD4-B的异源表达成功恢复了拟南芥sard4突变体中NHP葡萄糖苷的积累，证实了生化能力并提示小麦中存在替代性代谢冗余。这些发现定义了小麦中系统层面的NHP驱动免疫状态，并为解析谷类作物系统免疫提供了概念框架，将SAR范式扩展至模式植物系统之外。

papers.title: Is the Bitter Lesson coming to genomic prediction? An untuned tabular foundation model matches or beats specialized methods
papers.translated_title: 苦涩教训是否正降临基因组预测？一个未经调优的表格基础模型匹敌或超越专门方法
papers.author: Flagel, L.
papers.summary: Genomic prediction (GP) is dominated by models designed around assumptions about how genetic variation affects phenotypes. Here we asked how well a general-purpose pretrained tabular foundation model called TabPFN-3.5 does with no genetics-specific modeling and no tuning when given marker genotypes directly. We benchmarked TabPFN-3.5 using a published comparison of 18 GP methods on 18 traits in six plant species. Against the published means, TabPFN-3.5 ranked first on 11 of 18 traits and had the best median rank. Because the published benchmark did not identify its test sets, we reran GBLUP, RKHS and elastic-net models on the same splits as TabPFN-3.5. Against the best of these, TabPFN-3.5 was significantly behind on only one trait, spruce wood density, and ahead on 12 of 18, with significant gains on all three soybean traits and rice flowering time. In the soybean panel, which had the largest number of lines, its advantage was clearest. In leave-families-out cross-validation, where models were trained on some soybean families and used to predict lines from other families withheld from training, every model lost accuracy and TabPFN-3.5 performed on par with GBLUP and RKHS. That a general-purpose learner matches or exceeds decades of specialized GP models is consistent with Sutton's Bitter Lesson, which holds that methods that scale with computation eventually overtake those built on human knowledge of the domain.
papers.translated_summary: 基因组预测（GP）领域长期由基于遗传变异如何影响表型这一假设所设计的模型主导。本文探讨了一个通用预训练表格基础模型TabPFN-3.5在直接输入标记基因型、不进行遗传学特异性建模且不调参的情况下的表现。我们利用一项已发表的比较研究对TabPFN-3.5进行基准测试，该研究在六种植物物种的18个性状上比较了18种GP方法。与已发表的均值相比，TabPFN-3.5在18个性状中的11个上排名第一，并具有最佳的中位排名。由于已发表的基准测试未明确其测试集，我们在与TabPFN-3.5相同的划分上重新运行了GBLUP、RKHS和弹性网模型。与这些模型中表现最佳者相比，TabPFN-3.5仅在云杉木材密度这一个性状上显著落后，在18个性状中的12个上领先，在大豆的全部三个性状和水稻开花时间上均有显著提升。在大豆面板中，其品系数目最多，TabPFN-3.5的优势最为明显。在留家族交叉验证中，模型在一些大豆家族上训练并用于预测未参与训练的其他家族品系，所有模型的准确率均下降，TabPFN-3.5的表现与GBLUP和RKHS相当。一个通用学习器能够匹配或超越数十年来专门化的GP模型，这与Sutton的“苦涩教训”相一致，即随计算规模扩展的方法最终会超越那些基于人类领域知识构建的方法。

papers.title: Endogenous Osteoblast-Osteocyte-Osteoclast Signaling Enables Bone Remodeling, Drug Response, and Cancer Invasion in a Nanoscale Calcified Bone-on-a-Chip
papers.translated_title: 内源性成骨细胞-骨细胞-破骨细胞信号传导在纳米级钙化骨芯片中实现骨重塑、药物反应和癌症侵袭
papers.author: Sousa, M. G. C.
papers.summary: Bone homeostasis depends on spatially orchestrated interactions among osteoclasts, osteoblasts, and osteocytes within a unique microenvironment characterized by an extracellular matrix that is mineralized on the nanoscale. Reconstructing these interactions to enable autonomous cell differentiation and tissue remodeling remains a significant challenge in faithfully modeling bone physiology and disease in-vitro. Here, we present an engineered bone-on-a-chip platform that recapitulates the spatial organization of bone-resident cells, the differentiation of immune cells into osteoclasts, and calcified tissue resorption. We demonstrate that nanoscale mineralization of cell-laden collagen hydrogels is associated with ossification- and matrix-associated transcriptional changes and an osteocyte-like phenotype in osteoblast-lineage cells, while establishing a multicellular microenvironment associated with pro-osteoclastogenic RANKL/OPG signaling and supporting osteoclastogenesis and remodeling without the need for exogenous growth factors. Mineralized niche-driven osteoclastogenesis on-a-chip supported greater osteoclast differentiation than conventional stimulation with RANKL and M-CSF and reproduced differential responses to clinically used anti-resorptive drugs. The model further supports the integration of vascular networks and reproduces features of established tumor-bone interactions, including distinct spatial distributions of different cancer types within the mineralized microenvironment. Together, the findings establish a robust, self-regulated, and versatile microphysiologic model for investigating bone remodeling, cancer-bone crosstalk, and therapeutic interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 骨稳态依赖于破骨细胞、成骨细胞和骨细胞在独特微环境中的空间协同相互作用，该微环境的细胞外基质具有纳米级矿化特征。重建这些相互作用以实现细胞自主分化和组织重塑，仍然是体外忠实模拟骨生理学和疾病的一大挑战。在此，我们提出了一种工程化骨芯片平台，该平台重现了骨驻留细胞的空间组织、免疫细胞向破骨细胞的分化以及钙化组织的吸收。我们证明，载细胞胶原水凝胶的纳米级矿化与骨化和基质相关的转录变化以及成骨谱系细胞中的骨细胞样表型相关，同时建立了与促破骨细胞生成性RANKL/OPG信号相关的多细胞微环境，并在无需外源性生长因子的情况下支持破骨细胞生成和重塑。矿化微环境驱动的芯片上破骨细胞生成比传统RANKL和M-CSF刺激支持更强的破骨细胞分化，并重现了对临床使用的抗骨吸收药物的差异性反应。该模型进一步支持血管网络的整合，并重现了已建立的肿瘤-骨相互作用的特征，包括不同癌症类型在矿化微环境中的独特空间分布。总之，这些发现建立了一个稳健、自我调节且多功能的微生理学模型，用于研究骨重塑、癌症-骨交互作用以及治疗干预。

papers.title: Engineering the Lr67-associated G144R substitution by prime editing enhances leaf rust resistance in wheat
papers.translated_title: 通过先导编辑构建Lr67相关的G144R替换增强小麦叶锈病抗性
papers.author: Waites, J.
papers.summary: Wheat rust diseases threaten global wheat production, highlighting the need for durable sources of resistance. The Lr67-associated G144R substitution in the sugar transport protein gene TaSTP13-D1 confers broad-spectrum resistance to multiple fungal pathogens. Here, we used an enhanced prime-editing system (ePPEplus) to introduce this resistance-associated substitution into the three TaSTP13 homoeologs in hexaploid wheat. Using the wheat-compatible JWPE1 vector, we achieved editing frequencies of 84 to 92% across the A, B, and D genomes in regenerated T0 plants. Homozygous edits were recovered in all three homoeologs, including one line carrying homozygous edits across all three genomes. Disease assays showed that edited lines had reduced leaf rust severity and fungal biomass compared with susceptible controls. Notably, the line carrying edits in all three homoeologs exhibited the greatest reduction in fungal biomass. These results demonstrate the potential of prime editing to directly introduce resistance-associated alleles into wheat and provide a strategy for accelerating the development of rust-resistant cultivars.
papers.translated_summary: 小麦锈病威胁全球小麦生产，凸显了对持久抗性来源的需求。糖转运蛋白基因TaSTP13-D1中与Lr67相关的G144R替换赋予了对多种真菌病原体的广谱抗性。在此，我们利用增强型引导编辑系统（ePPEplus）将这一抗性相关替换引入六倍体小麦的三个TaSTP13同源基因中。使用小麦兼容的JWPE1载体，我们在再生T0植株的A、B和D基因组中实现了84%至92%的编辑频率。在所有三个同源基因中均获得了纯合编辑，包括一个在全部三个基因组中携带纯合编辑的株系。病害试验表明，与感病对照相比，编辑株系的叶锈病严重度和真菌生物量降低。值得注意的是，在全部三个同源基因中携带编辑的株系表现出最大的真菌生物量降低。这些结果证明了引导编辑将抗性相关等位基因直接引入小麦的潜力，并为加速抗锈病品种的培育提供了策略。

papers.title: Primate Saccade Rhythmicity
papers.author: Näher, T.
papers.summary: Rhythmic sampling is a hallmark of many sensory systems across diverse organisms. In primate vision, rapid foveating eye movements repetitively sample the visual environment at a rate of approximately 4 Hz. Yet, the observed inter-saccadic interval distributions might equally well be produced by a non-rhythmic stochastic process as by a - putatively variable- rhythmic generator. This raises the fundamental question whether primate visual sampling differs from the numerous examples of rhythmic sampling strategies exhibited across sensory modalities and species. Here, using experiments in humans, macaques, and a marmoset, as well as statistical approaches adopted from studies of temporal structure in neuronal spiking patterns, we show that primate saccade generation is unambiguously rooted in a rhythmic source. This finding was remarkably consistent across the three primate species despite their significant evolutionary distance. Importantly, we find that saccade rate undergoes smooth, slow fluctuations on the scale of seconds, and accounting for those rate fluctuations was crucial for revealing the true degree of saccade rhythmicity. Thus, exact saccade timing is determined by an interaction between the slow saccade-rate fluctuations and the more temporally-local rhythmic generator. This demonstration of rhythmicity in overt oculomotor sampling behavior provides a link to the fundamentally rhythmic nature of many central perceptual and cognitive processes, and places primate saccadic sampling into the large family of rhythmic active sampling behaviors.
papers.translated_summary: 节律性采样是众多生物多种感觉系统的标志性特征。在灵长类视觉中，快速的中央凹眼动以约4 Hz的频率重复采样视觉环境。然而，观察到的眼跳间期分布同样可能由非节律性随机过程产生，也可能由假定的可变节律性发生器产生。这引出了一个根本性问题：灵长类视觉采样是否不同于跨感觉通道和物种中众多节律性采样策略的实例。本文通过人类、猕猴和狨猴的实验，以及借鉴神经元尖峰模式时间结构研究的统计方法，我们表明灵长类眼跳的产生明确根植于节律性来源。这一发现在三个灵长类物种中高度一致，尽管它们之间存在显著的进化距离。重要的是，我们发现眼跳率在秒级尺度上经历平滑、缓慢的波动，而考虑这些速率波动对于揭示眼跳节律性的真实程度至关重要。因此，精确的眼跳时序由缓慢的眼跳率波动与更局部时间尺度的节律性发生器之间的相互作用决定。这一在外显眼动采样行为中展示的节律性，为许多核心知觉和认知过程的基本节律性本质提供了联系，并将灵长类眼跳采样归入节律性主动采样行为这一大类。

papers.title: EPHB2 promotes long-range axon extension and its variants cause callosal dysgenesis
papers.translated_title: EPHB2促进长距离轴突延伸，其变异导致胼胝体发育不良
papers.author: Park, S. S.
papers.summary: The corpus callosum (CC) is the largest fibre tract connecting the cerebral hemispheres, essential for integrating neural activity across large-scale brain networks. Accordingly, abnormal CC development is associated with diverse neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric disorders. Callosal projection neurons (CPNs) of the cortex form the CC by extending long-range axons to the contralateral hemisphere; however, the mechanisms that sustain axon elongation over such remarkable distances remain poorly understood. Here we show that variants in the human gene EPHB2, which encodes a tyrosine kinase receptor regulating nervous system development and implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders, cause CC dysgenesis. We characterise variant- specific effects on EPHB2 signalling and demonstrate that variants identified in individuals with distinct CC morphologies differentially alter CPN axon outgrowth and integration in vivo. We further show that EphB2 has a cell-autonomous, ligand-independent function in promoting CPN axon outgrowth by spatially organising actomyosin at axonal growth cones. These findings reveal a previously unrecognised role for EphB2 in promoting long-range axon extension and provide the first evidence that EPHB2 variants cause CC dysgenesis in humans. More broadly, our study links molecular variation in EPHB2 to individualised abnormalities in brain connectivity and provides a framework for understanding how heterogeneous circuit-level phenotypes arise in neurodevelopmental disorders.
papers.translated_summary: 胼胝体（CC）是连接大脑半球的最大纤维束，对于整合大规模脑网络中的神经活动至关重要。因此，胼胝体发育异常与多种神经发育和神经精神疾病相关。皮层的胼胝体投射神经元（CPNs）通过向对侧半球延伸长距离轴突而形成胼胝体；然而，维持轴突在如此显著距离上伸长的机制仍知之甚少。本研究表明，人类基因EPHB2的变异会导致胼胝体发育不良，该基因编码一种调节神经系统发育并与神经发育障碍相关的酪氨酸激酶受体。我们表征了变异对EPHB2信号传导的特定影响，并证明在具有不同胼胝体形态的个体中鉴定的变异差异性地改变CPN轴突在体内的生长和整合。我们进一步表明，EphB2通过空间组织轴突生长锥处的肌动球蛋白，以细胞自主、不依赖配体的方式促进CPN轴突生长。这些发现揭示了EphB2在促进长距离轴突延伸中此前未被认识的作用，并提供了EPHB2变异导致人类胼胝体发育不良的首个证据。更广泛而言，我们的研究将EPHB2的分子变异与脑连接的个体化异常联系起来，并为理解神经发育障碍中异质性环路水平表型如何产生提供了框架。

papers.title: Do altered neural responses during self-reflection converge across psychiatric disorders? A systematic review and meta-analysis of neuroimaging studies
papers.translated_title: 自我反思过程中改变的神经反应是否在不同精神疾病之间趋同？一项神经影像研究的系统综述与元分析
papers.author: Zhu, S.
papers.summary: Altered neural responses during self-reflection have been reported across psychiatric disorders, but it is unknown whether there exist common brain regions across studies. To fill the gap, we conducted a systematic review and coordinate-based activation likelihood estimation (ALE) meta-analysis of task-based neuroimaging studies. Through systematic literature search and article screening, we identified 36 studies across 8 diagnostic categories, of which 25 studies were eligible for the ALE meta-analysis. Qualitatively, these studies revealed altered neural response among psychiatric disorders in brain regions include cortical midline and lateral association regions. ALE analyses were conducted separately for self-versus other and self-versus control contrasts, the former identified convergence in the right anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), and the latter found converged activation in the left middle frontal gyrus (MFG). These findings revealed a broad interest in neural response to self-evaluation but unevenly distributed studies across psychiatric disorders, and the available results only provided weak evidence of spatial convergence for altered neural response across psychiatric disorders.
papers.translated_summary: 在精神疾病中已有报道自我反思时神经反应发生改变，但尚不清楚不同研究之间是否存在共同脑区。为填补这一空白，我们对基于任务的神经影像研究进行了系统综述和基于坐标的激活似然估计（ALE）元分析。通过系统文献检索和文章筛选，我们共识别出涵盖8个诊断类别的36项研究，其中25项研究符合ALE元分析的条件。定性分析显示，这些研究揭示了精神疾病患者在包括皮层中线及外侧联合区在内的脑区存在神经反应改变。ALE分析分别针对自我对他人和自我对控制条件的对比进行，前者发现右侧前扣带回（ACC）的激活汇聚，后者发现左侧额中回（MFG）的激活汇聚。这些发现表明，学界对自我评价的神经反应有广泛兴趣，但跨精神疾病的研究分布不均，且现有结果仅为精神疾病间神经反应改变的空间汇聚提供了微弱证据。

papers.title: Mathematical model for visual cortical development based on molecular mechanisms underlying the generation and elimination of dendritic spines
papers.translated_title: 基于树突棘生成与消除的分子机制的视觉皮层发育数学模型
papers.author: Tanaka, S.
papers.summary: In the developing brain, neural circuits are elaborated by the activity-dependent rewiring of synaptic connections. The current view of synaptic rewiring in early development is that filopodia spontaneously generated along dendrites transform into spines by establishing contacts with neighboring axonal boutons to form synapses whereas spines of inappropriate synapses are eliminated in an activity-dependent manner. In this theoretical study, we mainly focus on the processes of spine generation, maturation, and elimination to build a mathematical model of synaptic rewiring, incorporating experimental findings on actin polymerization and depolymerization under the activation of Rho-GTPases mediated by the binding of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) to neurotrophin receptors such as tropomyosin kinase receptor B (TrkB) and the low-affinity-nerve growth factor receptor (p75NTR). TrkB receptors are dephosphorylated by chondroitin sulphate proteoglycans (CSPGs) mediated by protein-tyrosine phosphatase {sigma} (PTP{sigma} in an age-dependent manner. The model describes the generation or elimination of dendritic spines of visual cortical neurons under actin polymerization and depolymerization to establish appropriate synaptic contacts on afferent fibers of cells in the lateral geniculate nucleus. The simulations based on the model reproduced not only simple-cell-like receptive fields and orientation-direction maps but also a characteristic profile of the total number of synapses, which shows an early increase and a delayed decrease during the critical period. It is also demonstrated that the formation of direction selectivity is delayed behind the formation of orientation selectivity, which is likely promoted by the pruning of inappropriate synapses.
papers.translated_summary: 在发育中的大脑里，神经回路是通过突触连接的活动依赖性重塑而精细形成的。目前关于早期发育中突触重塑的观点是：沿树突自发产生的丝状伪足通过与邻近轴突终末建立接触而形成突触，从而转变为树突棘；而不适当突触的树突棘则以活动依赖的方式被消除。在这项理论研究中，我们主要关注树突棘的生成、成熟和消除过程，以构建突触重塑的数学模型，并结合实验发现：在脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）与神经营养素受体（如原肌球蛋白激酶受体B（TrkB）和低亲和力神经生长因子受体（p75NTR））结合所介导的Rho-GTP酶激活下，肌动蛋白发生聚合和解聚。TrkB受体被硫酸软骨素蛋白聚糖（CSPGs）通过蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶σ（PTPσ）以年龄依赖的方式去磷酸化。该模型描述了在肌动蛋白聚合和解聚作用下，视觉皮层神经元树突棘的生成或消除，从而在外侧膝状体细胞传入纤维上建立适当的突触接触。基于该模型的模拟不仅再现了简单细胞样感受野和朝向-方向图，还再现了突触总数的特征性变化曲线，即在关键期内呈现早期增加和延迟减少。研究还表明，方向选择性的形成滞后于朝向选择性的形成，而后者很可能受到不适当突触修剪的促进。
